why: Owner, 2026-11-24: one of Kingdom 2's caves becomes a sewer (Ninja Turtles), entered Super-Mario-style through a floor hatch she holds and hauls open (rusty creak) and drops into; inside she falls onto a platform that goes down; a pipe-smith NPC forges a shield from MIREJAW's shed skin (slower, more defence). His answers: the sewer is UNDERTOW's caves; a new robot smith in the sewer; swimming not yet; the shield on her back like a shell.

stills.note: job ids recorded by their first eight characters as they were noted at firing; the hero sheets embed her canon element

music.delivery: seam cut 2 s in with a 2 s triangular crossfade of the head over the tail; loudnorm -17 LUFS, limiter at 0.7 (-2.4 dBTP after AAC); as fired in source/music/mus_sewer_asfired.mp3

delivery.hero strips: tools/stepstrip.cjs hatchhero_<w>.png --cell 320 --body 168 --floor 296 --frames 8 --feet (scraps under 4% of a cell removed), then tools/towebp.cjs 0.88
delivery.smith: VP9 transcode, tools/vidstrip.cjs 16 cells of 320, scaled to 192
delivery.plates: trimmed, seated on the cell floor, 256 (items) / 320 (smith), webp 0.88

hole_2026_11_25.why: Owner, 2026-11-25: the floor where she jumps in should show like a hole in the ground, as if something broke the floor. The hatch is now a sunk grate in a smashed slab with the shaft cut down below it.
hole_2026_11_25.delivery: four 336-px cells; the black above the slab keyed by a flood from the top (nothing below the slab touched), the slab faded out at both sides and the bottom so it melts into the real floor; drawn with its row 296 (the slab back edge) on the floor line at 0.8 vertical scale (js/sewer.js SW_HATCH)
